The '''Intarsa League''' was a criminal organization that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
The Intarsa League were led by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Dersa Welles]] and arrived in Cularin system in c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. After spending a brief time operating in the outer reaches of the system, they realized that they were outclassed by the various [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] groups that were based in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]], so the League relocated to the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. There, they began running a number of scams in Tolea Biqua and in the [[platform city]] [[Bayonard]] on the nearby planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. However, the League was attacked by a rival criminal faction and their [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] crashed within the grounds of Cularin's [[Blue Star Centre]]. The League took refuge inside the building and held the center's occupants hostage. Welles demanded that the group that attacked the Intarsa League be taken into custody, and that the League be provided with a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and be allowed to leave the centre unmolested. Eventually, the [[Office of Peace and Security]] assaulted the center, where they fought and defeated the League.
